question_title: Will the fastest official time at the 2026 World Bog Snorkelling Championships be under 1:15.00?
summary: Sub-1:15 is essentially a Neil-Rutter-only phenomenon — his 2023 record (1:12.35) is the only sub-1:15 time ever recorded at these championships. YES requires both that Rutter competes in 2026 (~70%, given his 2025 return but unconfirmed status) AND that he swims a near-record time (~25-30%, since even he usually finishes ~1:18, breaking 1:15 in only 1 of ~3 recent appearances). The non-Rutter field consistently runs 1:22+. Conditional decomposition yields ~0.70×0.27 + 0.30×0.02 ≈ 0.19, discounted slightly to ~0.15 for status-quo stickiness and Rutter's typical above-threshold finishes.
